scope: THz-TDS numeric data for agricultural/biological materials, prioritising China; repository records are research deposits, not government reference standards
verification_policy: File listing is distinguished from numeric content inspection. Paper figures and Data Availability statements alone do not prove that raw sample/reference traces are downloadable.
central_finding: A Chinese sugar-powder/solution THz-TDS deposit has a directly inspectable TXT archive manifest including reference files. A Chinese maize study declares a substantial processed absorption-spectrum dataset, but its Zenodo files could not be verified. The Chinese rice-seed deposit lists a ZIP, but its measurement mode and internal arrays remain unverified. None supplies acid-jujube geographic-origin labels.

records.priority: High for plant-powder method benchmarking, conditional on obtaining the actual data files
records.title: Quantitative analysis of genetically modified maize based on terahertz spectroscopy and DeepSpectra models
records.institution: Henan University of Technology and collaborators
records.sample_and_labels: GA21 genetically modified maize mixtures in six concentration groups: blank (<0.8 g/kg), 0.1%, 0.5%, 1%, 2%, 5%. This is mixture-level classification/quantification, not geographic origin.
records.independent_sample_grain: 1080 pressed pellets (180 per group); each pellet scanned three times and averaged to form one spectrum. Six outliers removed, leaving 1074 spectra; do not treat 3240 scans as independent biological samples.
records.thickness_and_preparation: 200 mg powder per pellet, 10 MPa pressure, approximately 13 mm diameter and 1.2 mm thickness
records.original_format: Not verified: repository page, API and export endpoints were inaccessible via the web retrieval tool

fields.time: Shown/discussed in article; inclusion of raw time traces in repository unverified
fields.reference: Reference measurements discussed in article; numeric reference traces in repository unverified
fields.frequency: Article specifies 121-point 0.2–1.2 THz grid; actual frequency-column format unverified
fields.n: Refractive index examined in article; repository inclusion unverified
fields.alpha: Article states absorption spectra are used and Data Availability promises preprocessed THz spectra; actual matrix not inspected
fields.labels: Article declares sample labels and train/test splits in repository; files not inspected

records.license: Dataset license unverified; article license must not be substituted for repository-data license
records.download_status: Author-declared public dataset; repository file list and downloads not verified in this session
records.usefulness: Potentially the strongest plant-powder dataset in this search for CARS/UVE/PCA/SVM/PLS/BPNN/CNN comparisons once downloaded; concentration task can test regression and calibration methods.
records.limitations: No origin labels or cross-region batches; a published train/test score cannot establish acid-jujube provenance accuracy or cross-instrument transfer. Preserve pellet-level grouping and inspect preparation-batch dependence before evaluating few-shot adaptation.
records.next_action: Open the DOI in a normal browser or contact authors only if the user later requests contact; obtain archive, manifest, license and pellet/batch IDs before scheduling a benchmark.

records.priority: High thematic relevance; provisional THz-TDS candidate pending archive inspection
records.title: Rice seed dataset
records.country_or_region: China (related article authors at East China Jiaotong University and Zhejiang University)
records.repository: Mendeley Data, research repository operated by Elsevier
records.method: Repository says terahertz spectral and imaging data for rice seed plumpness. Public publisher abstract specifies spectral imaging and absorbance-based classification; THz-TDS acquisition mode has not been verified from the available full methods or numeric files.
records.method_verified_from: Repository description and publisher abstract/highlights; not a verified raw THz-TDS dataset yet
records.sample_and_labels: Related article classifies sample-free background, empty-shell regions and full-kernel regions; this is regional image/pixel classification rather than geographic origin.
records.independent_sample_grain: Independent seeds, pixels per seed, repeated scans and split grouping not verified
records.thickness_and_preparation: Intact thin-shell rice seeds in related article; numeric path lengths/thickness metadata not verified
records.spectral_range: Related article: 0.5–3.0 THz, 329 original spectral channels reduced to eight by UVE-SPA
records.original_format: ZIP container verified in official repository comparison-page search rendering; internal numeric formats not inspected
records.file_manifest_verified: Top-level archive name and size only, via official comparison page indexed content

fields.frequency: 329-channel THz image spectra described in related article; array/axis layout unverified
fields.alpha: Absorbance parameter imaging is described; this is not sufficient to assert physical absorption coefficient alpha arrays
fields.labels: Region types described in article; actual archive label encoding unverified

records.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International, verified from repository record
records.download_status: Public record and top-level archive metadata verified; archive not downloaded or extracted
records.article_data_statement_conflict: Publisher article currently says data may be obtained from authors upon reasonable request, whereas the separately published Mendeley v3 record lists a public ZIP. Archive completeness and exact paper correspondence require inspection.
records.usefulness: CARS, UVE, SPA, SVM and KNN closely match the teacher-provided algorithm family; potentially useful for verifying a feature-selection pipeline on seed THz images.
records.limitations: Cannot reuse the reported 98.33% test result as an independently reproduced score. Pixel leakage between seeds must be ruled out. No acid-jujube origin or constituent-concentration labels.
records.next_action: Download the 8.34 MB v3 ZIP, inspect acquisition documentation and sample-level labels, and determine whether it contains raw time-domain traces or only spectral/image derivatives.

records.priority: Best verified raw-file manifest for a small THz-TDS preprocessing reference; not a plant-cohort benchmark
records.title: Terahertz spectral properties of glucose and two disaccharides in solid and liquid states
records.institution: Capital Normal University, Beijing, and associated Ministry of Education/Beijing THz laboratories
records.repository: Zenodo, general research repository hosted by CERN
records.method: Transmission THz time-domain spectroscopy for solid saccharide pellets; THz-TDS with a microfluidic chip for aqueous solutions
records.method_verified_from: iScience article experimental setup and sample-preparation sections
records.sample_and_labels: Main study D-glucose, alpha-lactose hydrate and beta-maltose hydrate. Additional pinyin-labelled controls/materials appear in archives; these must be decoded from documentation rather than treated as additional known class labels.
records.independent_sample_grain: Archive lists paired -1w/-2w files per material; whether these are repeated scans, independent pellets or another acquisition setting is unverified. Do not infer large sample counts.
records.thickness_and_preparation: Solid study samples mixed 1:1 by mass with polyethylene, pressed at 3 t, 12 mm diameter and 1 mm thickness. Reported aqueous concentrations are 0.5, 0.1 and 0.5 g/mL for glucose, lactose and maltose respectively; actual raw-file correspondence and liquid path length need inspection.
records.original_format: Two small ZIP archives containing TXT files; separate CIF/XSD files are molecular structures/simulations, not biological training spectra

file_entries.filename: Raw data of solid state D-Glucose, α-Lactose hydrate and β-Maltose.zip
Raw data of liquid state D-Glucose, α-Lactose hydrate and β-Maltose.zip

fields.time: Raw TXT files are explicitly listed and article acquisition is THz-TDS; actual columns, time units and trace sampling have not been read
fields.reference: Reference-labelled TXT files verified in both archive manifests; values and exact reference composition/geometry not read
fields.frequency: Derived THz absorption spectra in paper; separate frequency arrays in archives not verified
fields.alpha: Article reports absorption spectra; whether alpha is stored or must be recomputed is unverified
fields.labels: Material names encoded in filenames; no geographical-origin labels or batch table verified

records.license: Official landing page displays an empty License field in the retrievable text; dataset reuse license unconfirmed. The paper is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, which does not establish a separate data license.
records.download_status: Public download links and full ZIP member lists verified through official Zenodo preview; archive bytes and numeric columns not downloaded/read
records.usefulness: Small controlled materials can validate file import, baseline/reference handling, FFT, frequency-grid alignment and peak consistency. Solid pellet geometry is closer to herb powder THz-TDS than NIR/FTIR libraries.
records.limitations: Three main pure substances and a few raw traces do not support reliable plant-origin accuracy estimates, few-shot performance claims or direct spinosin/jujuboside identification.
records.next_action: Download the two archives (about 80 kB combined), inspect TXT columns and acquisition notes, clarify -1w/-2w and control names, and verify license before redistributing.

non_tds_comparator.name: NIST Chemistry WebBook THz Spectral Database
non_tds_comparator.status: Official U.S. government numerical reference library; 36 material entries inspected in earlier search
non_tds_comparator.numerical_format: JCAMP-DX links verified for cellulose and corn starch
non_tds_comparator.exclusion_reason: Database guide describes modified FTIR measurements of powder/PE pellets, rather than the user's THz-TDS time/reference traces. It is useful for peak comparisons, not pooled same-instrument origin-classification training.

excluded_categories: metamaterial/CST simulation without measured bulk plant spectra
shared_caveat: No verified dataset here is a multi-region acid-jujube seed THz-TDS reference matrix. None can establish universal geographic identification, spinosin/jujuboside content, or a numeric performance claim on the user's samples without matching experimental metadata, reference assays and grouped validation.
